newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian new house sales rising - survey.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian new house sales rising - survey.

text.p: Australia's new house sales in the three months to January rose to 24,080, up 3.9 percent on the previous three months, a housing survey found on Monday.
But the Housing Industry Association data, which is not seasonally adjusted, showed sales were 5.0 percent down on the corresponding period a year before.

"The housing industry has made a promising start to the new year with builders landing more orders to construct single-dwelling houses," Association managing director Ron Silberberg said in a statement.
Sales activity had picked up in January after a disappointing performance in December, he said.
"The more reliable trend estimate shows that sales activity is now running at nearly nine percent above the low point of the housing cycle in mid-1996."
However, the positive effects of lower interest rates were being undermined by employment uncertainty, he said.
